title: The Family Predator Pretending To Be a Dad
description:
#news #police #arrest

On October 6, 2025, a school resource officer notified the Marion County Sheriff’s Office that a student had reported an incident of sexual battery involving her dad. An MCSO deputy met with the student/victim, who alleged that he had sexually abused them two days earlier. This is body-cam footage of the events.

arrest, the Florida Department of Law Enforcement conducted a DNA comparison on the evidence
the victim so bravely refused to wash. The results were undeniable, placing Gates's DNA
exactly where she said it would be. Investigators also pulled his cell phone records, perfectly
mapping his location to the secluded, sandy area by the lake where the vehicle got stuck.
At trial, prosecutors laid out the full scope of his manipulation, including a $100
bribe that he used to try and buy her silence. On April 9th, a jury saw through the excuses,
e fake heart attacks, and the desperate deflections we watched during his arrest.
Donald Ronald Gates III was found guilty of human trafficking of a child for commercial
sexual activity, lewd or lascivious molestation, and sex battery upon a child by a person
in custodial authority. The judge sentenced him to spend the rest of his natural life behind bars.
The question this case leaves behind isn't about what just happened at the lake. It's about
the environment that allowed it to fester. A home where a stepmother was too terrified of the fallout
to dial 911, a community where witnesses saw a grown man stuck in the woods with a young girl,
thought it was weird and just drove away.
